summary: One named Durable Object whose alarm reschedules itself every minute forever, running at most 10 due jobs per tick from a table capped at 50 rows.

must_not_flag.reason: The alarm never stops, but its rate has a limit: one object (idFromName of a constant), a fixed 60-second interval on every path including the error path, and at most 10 jobs per tick from a table capped at 50 rows. That is about 43,200 requests and under a million rows written a month, inside the included allowance. Each job's next_run_at is moved forward whether its call succeeds or fails, so a failing target is not retried back-to-back.
